group.ja: 温度制御・分子動力学

summary.ja: 熱浴変数にも別の熱浴を結合し、鎖状の拡張系を作る。単一熱浴での標本化の問題を改善するための発展形。
summary.en: Couple heat-bath variables to further heat baths in a chain. This extension addresses sampling problems of a single thermostat.

caution.ja: 鎖の長さ、質量、サブステップに依存する。鎖を加えるだけで任意の系のエルゴード性を保証するものではない。
caution.en: Chain length, masses and substeps matter. Adding a chain does not universally guarantee ergodicity.

references.label: Martyna, Klein & Tuckerman (1992), Nosé–Hoover chains: The canonical ensemble via continuous dynamics
references.scope: Bibliographic entry and introductory comparison; full derivation and numerical reproduction have not been audited.

next_deliverable.en: Add a dedicated formulation and integration recipe, followed by explicit-input distribution and time-correlation checks with stated degrees of freedom, random seeds and step sizes.
